name: demo
description: A film built from code: one beat-locked timeline drives picture and sound.

scripts.stills: remotion still Mark16 out/stills/mark-16.png --log=error && remotion still MarkSizes out/stills/mark-sizes.png --log=error && remotion still MarkLarge out/stills/mark-large.png --log=error
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && node scripts/lint-film.mjs src && tsx scripts/grid-check.ts src/timeline.ts
scripts.audio: python3 scripts/audio/score.py --cues out/cues.json --score audio/score.json --out public/audio/soundtrack.wav --stems out/stems --json out/qa/score.json
scripts.qa: mkdir -p out/qa && python3 scripts/probe.py out/film.mp4 --spec 1920x1080@60 && python3 scripts/forensics.py out/film.mp4 --cues out/cues.json --json out/qa/forensics.json && python3 scripts/av-audit.py out/film.mp4 --cues out/cues.json --stems out/stems --json out/qa/av.json && python3 scripts/sheet.py out/film.mp4 --out out/qa/sheet.png
